title: Robust TOA-based UAS navigation under model mismatch in GNSS-denied harsh environments
authors: Mortier J.; Pagès G.; Vilà-Valls J.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
